description.en: Shared high-intensity explicit pose library. Bold, glamorous, camera-aware geometry in the MetArt / WowGirls / Femjoy register. Intended for level 3–4 frames and for mixing into location pools. Every pose is written so the heat register and pose_openness scorer can read it cleanly.
description.fr: Bibliothèque partagée de poses explicites à haute intensité. Géométrie audacieuse, glamour et consciente de la caméra dans le registre MetArt / WowGirls / Femjoy. Destinée aux niveaux 3–4 et au mélange dans les pools de lieux.

note: Each entry follows the same shape as location prompt_pieces. type and _pose_class map to heat_register families. prompt is the body description only (no location). framing and camera_angle are suggestions the planner can override.

poses.prompt: on all fours on the surface, weight on both forearms and both knees, back strongly arched, hips pushed high and back toward the lens, both cheeks parted by the pose, the anus and the open folds beneath it fully visible and centred, face turned back over the right shoulder with a direct, unhurried gaze, full body readable
